articles.title: Teenager Hannah Klugman Wins Her Biggest Tennis Title Yet in Wrexham
articles.summary: Seventeen-year-old Hannah Klugman beat Elsa Jacquemot 6-2 6-4 to win the Wrexham Open W100 title without dropping a set all week.

articles.title: How the Makers of Buddy Turned a Unicorn Into a Surprise Hit
articles.summary: The makers of the 2026 film Buddy explained how they built a unicorn character with both light and dark sides, and a marketing campaign that made audiences fall for him first.

articles.title: Jay-Z Closes His Tour With Surprise Guests in Los Angeles
articles.summary: Jay-Z closed the Jay-Z 30 Tour at Los Angeles' SoFi Stadium by bringing out Snoop Dogg, Dr. Dre and Too Short for a medley of classic songs.
